messages:
Alyssa Chen: Kickoff for DataCity LLM Summit booth. Panel confirmed but lightning talk TBD. Need owners for speaker, swag, shipping, and lead flow. Who can take? :calendar:

Mike Patel: I'll take shipping & on-site logistics. Need final SKU counts and vendor lead times.

Sylvia Nguyen: Creative can finalize art by Tue. Proposed swag: stickers 2k, enamel pins 400, power banks 150, hoodies 60, totes 200. Can swap tote for recycled option.

Jordan Ruiz: I'll own speaker submissions + lead routing. Plan: QR -> short form -> Segment -> SFDC events queue with AE rotation. Fields: name, email, company, role, interest.

Priya Kaur: Growth will run a pre-event meetup and a post-conference webinar series. Need UTM stitching on the form for nurture.

Ram Singh: AV/power and lead-scanner on me. Venue COI due 2026-06-01. Freight elevator dims reported as 46\" x 34\"; crate max 44\"x32\".

Alyssa Chen: Vendor lead time is ~6 business days. Sylvia please cut PO after counts confirmed. Mike escalate freight if rush needed.

Sylvia Nguyen: Final counts locked: stickers 2000, pins 400, power banks 150, hoodies 60 (S10 M22 L18 XL8), totes 200. Uploading art tonight.

Mike Patel: Shipping plan draft:
Ship-to: Redwood Events / Mike Patel
Venue: DataCity Center, Booth B12
Ship window: 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-11
Carrier: compare FedEx vs LTL
Note: may need curbside lift (~$200) for large crate.

Jordan Ruiz: Speaker update: panelists locked: Alyssa, Dr. L. Chen, Marco (Partner). Lightning backup: Priya. Need a 1-slide sanitized benchmark.

Ram Singh: Sanitized metrics for slide:
Baseline throughput 42 tps -> Optimized 95 tps (+2.26x)
Median p95 latency 88ms -> 69ms
Token cost $0.0108 -> $0.0051 (quant + batching)
I'll create the slide and upload.

Jordan Ruiz: I'll build the short form and wire up Segment -> SFDC. Test payload example: {email: test+dc@redwood.ai, company: ExampleCo, role: ML Platform, interest: inference-cost, utm_source: qr_dc}. DevEx can you confirm the #sales-events webhook?

DevEx: Webhook exists. Share a sample and I'll validate.

Sylvia Nguyen: Request printing 500 QR cards (2.5\"x3.5\") linking to benchmark blog. Copy: "See the numbers: how we cut inference cost 2x. Scan for benchmarks & demo." CTA: "Get the benchmarks".

booth-bot: Reminder: swag order cutoff in 5 days per vendor SLA.

Alyssa Chen: Action items:
- Mike: confirm carrier & add lift if needed, publish booth schedule
- Sylvia: upload print-ready files & PO
- Jordan: submit lightning if Priya confirms, finalize form + tests
- Priya: confirm lightning content + draft webinar sequence
- Ram: AV + COI + freight coordination
Check-in in 24h. :rocket:
